name: Basis
english_description: A small, historically significant 1993 English-language LPMud mudlib by John Garnett ("Truilkan", also the author of the already-onboarded tmi2/TMI-2, but this is an earlier, deliberately smaller project). A thin core-infrastructure sketch rather than a game: a two-room test area, a working registration/login flow, and a real bin/-command dispatch tree, but no quests, combat, or score command. Basis's std/ base classes, groups/access permission model, and bin command-dispatch system were later inherited by TMI-2 itself. The most severe porting bug was in this project's own conversion tooling: a fixed-width extension-matching slice in the command-cache builder was left unwidened after the .c->.lpc rename, silently breaking every single command in the game. A second, non-obvious bug was a closure/function-pointer semantics gap -- old MudOS's (: object_or_path, "method" :) call_other pointer idiom only works on this driver when the head is a bare compile-time-resolved name, silently degrading to a no-op comma-expression otherwise, which crashed every `look` via a cascading self-referential virtual-object-compile fallback.
